title: Japan 10-Year JGB auction (¥2,600bn anticipated, first reopening of issue 384) — the arm MOF left alone and the BoJ cut hardest (−64.8%, the deepest of its six purchase buckets)
source: EST: mof.go.jp English November 2026 auction calendar (english/policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/2611e.htm), re-fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 25,187 bytes) for this initial research; parsed cell by cell, its table row reads 'Nov. 5, 2026 | 10-year'. The DATE is MOF's own. NO SIZE IS ASSERTED: no November row carries an 'Auction Announcement' href on 2026-09-09, `2612e.htm` still 404s, and MOF's note on the page reads verbatim 'Each issue amount will be announced about one week prior to each auction date'. ¥2,600bn is the anticipated base case from THREE MOF announcement pages read directly this session — announcement/auct20260625e.htm, auct20260728e.htm and auct20260825e.htm (all HTTP 200, fetched 2026-09-09) each read 'About 2,600 billion yen' for the 2026-07-02, 08-04 and 09-01 auctions — and from the Auction Results for JGBs workbook (english/policy/jgbs/auction/past_auction_results/Auction_Results_for_JGBs.xls, 492,032 bytes, last saved 2026-08-13, parsed 2026-09-09), whose 10年債 sheet shows ¥2,700bn at 2024-01-10 and ¥2,600bn at every auction from 2024-04-02 onward — one step, at the start of the window. THE ANNOUNCEMENT DATE IS A MEASURED RULE, NOT THE PAGE'S 'about': those same three announcements published on 2026-06-25, 07-28 and 08-25 for auctions on 07-02, 08-04 and 09-01 — exactly 7 days prior, 3 of 3 — putting the 2026-11-05 terms on 2026-10-29. THE ISSUE IDENTITY IS MOF-STATED RATHER THAN DERIVED, WHICH IS A STRONGER SOURCE THAN THE 30-YEAR FAMILY HAD: MOF prints the issue number in the calendar's Issue cell once an auction has settled, and 2608e.htm and 2609e.htm read '10-year(383)' for both 2026-08-04 and 2026-09-01, matching the workbook's 2026-07-02 opening of issue 383 (maturity 2036-06-20). Issue 383 has now had its three auctions (07-02, 08-04, 09-01), and across the 34 issues 350-383 (2018-03 -> 2026-07) the 10-year matures on the 20th of Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec (34 of 34), steps +3 months issue-to-issue (33 of 33), opens in Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct (33 of 34) and runs exactly three auctions (32 of 33 completed) — the single exception on the last two counts being issue 350, the window's own first issue, which opened 2018-03 and ran four. So 2026-10-06 opens issue 384 (expected maturity 2036-09-20) and 2026-11-05 is its FIRST REOPENING. Filed `estimate` on the two counts every JGB entry on this calendar records: the size is anticipated rather than announced, and market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: Proposed 2026-09-09 by the jgb-30y-auction-2026-11-10 sweep as 'the control arm the retired difference-in-differences actually needed' — the one JGB tenor MOF has not cut — with the honest limit stated in the proposal that it had NOT read the BoJ's purchase path for the 5-10y bucket. This session read it, from 32 monthly BoJ operation workbooks (boj.or.jp/en/statistics/boj/fm/ope/m_release, ope2401-ope2608.xlsx, all HTTP 200, parsed 2026-09-09), AND THE RATIONALE IS REFUTED — INVERTED, NOT MERELY WEAKENED. Successful purchases in the 'More than 5 years and up to 10 years' bucket ran ¥1,902.7bn/month in 2024-01 and ¥670.7bn in 2026-08: -64.8%, the DEEPEST cut of the BoJ's six maturity buckets (0-1y -33.2%, 1-3y -52.7%, 3-5y -62.3%, 5-10y -64.8%, 10-25y -55.4%, 25y+ -0.2%). A newly issued 10-year sits in the most-tapered bucket on the calendar, not an untreated one. And because MOF left 10-year issuance flat (-3.7% since 2024-01, one step), NET SUPPLY TO PRIVATE HANDS AT THIS TENOR ROSE +142.0% (¥797bn -> ¥1,929bn/month) — the largest increase of any tenor, against 10-25y -9.1% and 25y+ -45.5%. THE MECHANISM THAT WOULD PREDICT AUCTION DAMAGE FROM THAT IS ALSO REFUTED, cross-sectionally: tail share >=2bp, 2007-2023 -> 2024+, runs 2Y 0.5% -> 0.0%, 5Y 1.5% -> 0.0%, 10Y 3.4% -> 19.4%, 20Y 4.4% -> 32.3%, 30Y 4.7% -> 19.4% — the two deepest-dosed buckets after this one show ZERO deterioration and the UNDOSED 25y+ bucket shows a fourfold rise. Deterioration splits at 10 years, not at any BoJ bucket boundary. What survives is a PRICING association, sharpened: of the four bucket boundaries, only 25y carries a curve discontinuity (20s25s at the 93.5th percentile against 25s30s at the 1.2nd, a 92.3-point gap, on the 55.2pp dose gap) while 3y/5y/10y sit within 10 points of each other on dose gaps under 10pp. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is low for the reasons every sibling JGB ledger records: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure and no house playbook is rates-keyed. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
